body:
emily.chen: Heads-up—POC blocked: streaming + tool calls cause malformed JSON returned to customer. Repro below.
noah_roberts: Which customer and endpoint?
emily.chen: Blocked on PremierBank; using hosted /v1/chat.completions model redwood-xy-3-large. They call risk_tool then expect a single JSON object. Works with stream=false, fails with stream=true.
maya_eng: Paste sanitized stream chunks?
emily.chen:
[chunk] {"role":"tool","name":"risk_tool","content":"{\"risk\":\"low\"}"}
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"
Note: risk ok, returning result"}
[chunk] {"role":"assistant","content":"
{\"verdict\":{\"score\":0.05}}"}
[end stream]

noah_roberts: That middle assistant message injects plaintext between JSON fragments -> json.loads fails with Extra data.
emily.chen: Customer error: JSONDecodeError: Extra data at char 130. Stream=false works. They need streaming for latency SLA.
maya_eng: Short-term mitigations: 1) ask customer to set stream=false (ugly), 2) system prompt to enforce strict JSON: "OUTPUT_MODE: STRICT_JSON - produce one JSON object only, no commentary or fences." 3) SDK-side: assemble only assistant content after tool_end marker and strip surrounding backticks before parse.
security-bot: Security note: customer attached QSA with encryption-in-transit and key management questions. Need product contact to respond.
noah_roberts: Pricing/ops asks: can we provide Dedicated eval price for 4x-A100 equiv? Also ETA on runtime fix?
emily.chen: Provisional: list ~$40k/mo for 4x-A100 equivalent; we can offer a 30-day trial at ~25% off pending finance. Eng-runtime ETA: canary in ~72 hours, GA ~10 business days if CI passes.
maya_eng: There's an internal PR to add streaming framing tokens and a strict_json flag to runtime — will post link when CI green. deploy-bot: PR queued, unit tests passing, integration flaky tests retried.
noah_roberts: Action items: emily -> send provisional quote and schedule triage call; maya -> post PR link + mitigation snippet; security-bot -> draft QSA reply; ops -> consider quota bump for dedicated eval.
emily.chen: I'll send quote and invite. Please add a minimal reproducible test & logs to the invite so eng can reproduce live.
maya_eng: Quick mitigation snippet (pseudo):
buf = ''
for ev in stream:
  if ev['role'] == 'assistant':
    buf += ev['content']
buf = re.sub(r"^```+|```+$", "", buf)
try:
  parsed = json.loads(buf)
except Exception:
  # fallback to non-streaming or request retry
  raise

noah_roberts: That helped customers ~60% but not edge cases where assistant injects extra text between object members. Runtime fix needed.
emily.chen: Thanks all — I'll coordinate the call and loop finance & security.
